reviews.author: Chedva2014
reviews.text:
Leader Computers is an excellent place to get all your computer needs met. I have been using Leader Computers for 3 years.
We were very pleased when they fixed my old Dell laptop. We bought 2 iPads, and various connection cables. Leader Computers is dependable. They answer all my questions and respond to What's App messages and calls quickly.
English is spoken there, also Russian and Hebrew. Leader Computers is knowledgeable. I will continue going there whenever I have any computer needs. I am very satisfied with their work.
